node.label: muscular dystrophy-dystroglycanopathy (congenital with brain and eye anomalies), type A3
node.definition: An autosomal recessive muscular dystrophy caused by mutations in the POMGNT1 gene. It is associated with characteristic brain and eye malformations, profound mental retardation, and death usually in the first years of life.
synonyms: muscular dystrophy-dystroglycanopathy (congenital with brain and eye anomalies) type A, 3
muscular dystrophy-dystroglycanopathy (congenital with brain and eye anomalies), type A, 3
